sharedContract: One exact-rig paired limb asset in the approved soft plush 3D fantasy-creature style. Show exactly two separated left/right nodes, front orthographic, with visibly substantial rounded proximal plugs designed to disappear beneath the matching shoulder or hip receiver. No torso, pelvis, head, face, pedestal, hardware, flat cut, joined pair, labels, or extra appendages. Generous neutral checker-like margin supports deterministic alpha extraction.
